sections.title: ADMISSION SUMMARY
sections.content:
Dear Doctor,
 Thank you for your ongoing care of [___], a [age]-year-old [M/F] who presented to the [department] at [hospital] on [date] with <CIT id="c1">nausea, vomiting and dizziness</CIT> for <CIT id="c2">2/7 history</CIT>.
 The primary diagnosis is likely Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) given the positive Dix-Hallpike. Key symptoms included <CIT id="c3">unsteadiness on feet</CIT>, <CIT id="c4">exacerbated by head movement and sitting to standing</CIT>, and later onset <CIT id="c5">postural vertigo</CIT>. Relevant past medical history includes <CIT id="c6">Tricuspid atresia</CIT>, <CIT id="c7">single ventricle with Fontan circulation</CIT>, <CIT id="c8">refractory atrial tachyarrhythmias</CIT>, <CIT id="c9">AICD</CIT>, and <CIT id="c10">Obesity</CIT>.
 On examination, the patient appeared <CIT id="c11">uncomfortable</CIT> and required <CIT id="c12">1x assist to mobilise</CIT>. Neurological examination was otherwise unremarkable. A <CIT id="c13">CT brain + angio</CIT> was performed and was <CIT id="c14">negative</CIT> for acute pathology. A <CIT id="c15">Dix-Hallpike test was positive on the left</CIT>.
 Treatment included <CIT id="c16">Stemetil</CIT> and <CIT id="c17">IV fluids</CIT>. An <CIT id="c18">Epley’s manoeuvre was unsuccessful</CIT> in resolving symptoms. The patient's <CIT id="c19">symptoms are starting to improve</CIT> and they are now safe for discharge.

citations.context: M/F presenting with 2/7 hx of nausea, vomiting and dizziness
exacerbated by head movement and sitting to standing

sections.title: DISCHARGE PLAN
sections.content:
DISCHARGE PLAN
1. Discharge destination: Discharge home with wife and daughter.
2. Medications: Please continue all regular medications as prescribed.
3. Follow-up arrangements: Follow-up with your GP in 7 days for review of vertigo symptoms.
4. Safety netting: Please seek medical attention and/or present to your nearest emergency department if you experience:
   - Worsening dizziness or vertigo
   - New onset weakness or numbness
   - Difficulty speaking or swallowing
   - Severe headache
   - Any other concerning symptoms
Kind Regards, Dr [Physician], [Department] [Position]
